title: Leaderboard endpoint coerces 'viewed' apps to Submitted (missing case arm)
detail: Live leaderboard route (router.gleam:415) maps the DB status string to the enum but has no "viewed" arm. The unknown-fallback coerces a viewed row to Submitted, so it encodes as "submitted" (shared/leaderboard.gleam:49) and renders as a slate Submitted pill at sort rank 0, not a navy Viewed pill at rank 3. Violates AC #4 (leaderboard renders viewed without breaking).
recommended_fix: Add `"viewed" -> application.Viewed` between the shortlisted and approved arms in application_list_handler.gleam:89.

title: Status-PATCH reducer keeps old status for 'viewed' (UI does not reflect the new step)
evidence:
let updated_status = case new_status {
                "under_review" -> application.UnderReview
                "shortlisted" -> application.Shortlisted
                "approved" -> application.Approved
                "rejected" -> application.Rejected
                "auto_closed" -> application.AutoClosed
                _ -> app.status
              }
detail: This ApiReturnedStatusUpdate reducer (the single funnel for every status PATCH via dispatch_status_update -> update_application_status, client.gleam:5840) lacks a "viewed" arm. The `_ -> app.status` fallback keeps the OLD status, so after clicking the Viewed stepper stop the server updates but the UI stays on the prior step until reload. Violates AC #3 (UI reflects the new step).
recommended_fix: Add `"viewed" -> application.Viewed` to the case in client.gleam:3128, alongside the shortlisted arm.
